
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/xiaoniu142857/p/19947650" title="发布于 2026-04-28 22:03">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">洛谷-P9165 「INOH」Round 1 - 意外 题解</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<h2 id="solution">Solution</h2>
<p>由题意得，传输的数组长度必须 <span class="math inline">\(\le 750\)</span>。</p>
<p>最朴素的容错方式是增加冗余。假设需要传递 <span class="math inline">\(S\)</span> 个数值，每个数值重复传输 <span class="math inline">\(K=\left\lfloor\frac{750}{S}\right\rfloor\)</span> 份。由于模数大，篡改后的数可以认为各不相同。所以在 <span class="math inline">\(K\)</span> 份中只要正确的数字保留了 <span class="math inline">\(\ge 2\)</span> 份，就能通过取众数还原，否则该数值丢失。因此单个数成功概率为：</p>
<p></p><div class="math display">\[1-\frac{\binom{K}{0}+\binom{K}{1}}{2^K}=1-\frac{1+K}{2^K}
\]</div><p></p><p>最直接的想法是直接传原数组，每个数传 <span class="math inline">\(7\)</span> 份。这样单个数成功概率为 <span class="math inline">\(0.9375\)</span>，但是需要 <span class="math inline">\(100\)</span> 个数全部成功才行，总成功率为 <span class="math inline">\(0.9375^{100}\approx0\)</span>，没有前途。</p>
<p>能否找到一种方法，使得只需要任意 <span class="math inline">\(100\)</span> 个有效数值就能反推原数组？不妨考虑<strong>多项式表示法</strong>。</p>
<p>有两种构造多项式的方法：</p>
<ol>
<li><strong>数组作为点值</strong>：解码器需要做 <span class="math inline">\(N\)</span> 次 <span class="math inline">\(O(N^2)\)</span> 插值，总时间复杂度 <span class="math inline">\(O(N^3)\)</span>。</li>
<li><strong>数组作为系数</strong>：拉格朗日插值提供了 <span class="math inline">\(O(N^2)\)</span> 的点值转系数算法。</li>
</ol>
<p>综上，我们采用方法 2。</p>
<p>取 <span class="math inline">\(S=150\)</span>，<span class="math inline">\(K=5\)</span>，期望接收到 <span class="math inline">\(\approx121\)</span> 个有效点，成功率较高。</p>
<h2 id="code">Code</h2>
<pre><code class="language-cpp">#include &lt;bits/stdc++.h&gt;
#define rep(i,a,b) for(int i(a);i&lt;b;++i)
#define per(i,a,b) for(int i(a);i&gt;b;--i)
#define rept(i,a,b) for(int i(a);i&lt;=b;++i)
#define pert(i,a,b) for(int i(a);i&gt;=b;--i)
#define ll long long
#define eb emplace_back
using namespace std;
const int N=100,S=150,K=5;
const ll P=998244353;
ll ksm(ll x,ll y){
    ll res=1;
    while(y){
        if(y&amp;1) (res*=x)%=P;
        (x*=x)%=P,y&gt;&gt;=1;
    }
    return res;
}
vector&lt;int&gt; Encode(vector&lt;int&gt; vec){
    vector&lt;int&gt; res;
    res.reserve(S*K);
    rept(x,1,S){
        ll y=0;
        pert(i,N-1,0) y=(y*x+vec[i])%P;
        rep(i,0,K) res.eb(y);
    }
    return res;
}
vector&lt;ll&gt; lagrange(const vector&lt;ll&gt; &amp;x,const vector&lt;ll&gt; &amp;y){
    int n=x.size();
    vector&lt;ll&gt; p(n+1,0),q(n+1,0),res(n,0);
    p[0]=1;
    rep(i,0,n){
        pert(j,i,0){
            (p[j+1]+=p[j])%=P;
            (p[j]*=-x[i])%=P;
        }
    }
    rep(i,0,n){
        ll a=1,rem=p[n];
        rep(j,0,n) if(i^j) (a*=x[i]-x[j])%=P;
        a=ksm(a,P-2)*y[i]%P;
        pert(j,n-1,0){
            q[j]=rem;
            (rem=p[j]+rem*x[i]%P)%=P;
        }
        rep(j,0,n) (res[j]+=a*q[j]%P)%=P;
    }
    rep(i,0,n) (res[i]+=P)%=P;
    return res;
}
vector&lt;int&gt; Decode(vector&lt;int&gt; vec){
    vector&lt;ll&gt; x,y;
    x.reserve(N),y.reserve(N);
    rept(i,1,S){
        map&lt;int,int&gt; mp;
        rep(j,K*(i-1),K*i){
            ++mp[vec[j]];
            if(mp[vec[j]]&gt;=2){
                x.eb(i),y.eb(vec[j]);
                break;
            }
        }
        if(x.size()&gt;=N) break;
    }
    vector&lt;ll&gt; res=lagrange(x,y);
    return vector&lt;int&gt;(res.begin(),res.end());
}
</code></pre>


</div>
